title: Slot-claim replay gate: re-check claim_seq under s_coord_lock before applying
description: Codereview finding (P2, correctness+security) on coap_slot_coord.c:429-438 vs 453-502: the claim_seq gate lookup runs BEFORE k_mutex_lock(s_coord_lock) and the monotonic no-op in commit returns 0, so a stale lower-seq claim racing a higher-seq one can be applied after the newer grant (highest-seq-wins violated at the coordination layer). Latent today (single CoAP RX thread) but process_claim is public API. Fix: re-run the claim_seq gate inside the critical section just before conflict resolution (lookup under lock; s_coord_lock -> s_lock ordering already acyclic), or make lichen_slot_claim_seq_commit return a distinct nonzero (-EALREADY) from the monotonic no-op so process_claim rejects. Add a regression test for out-of-order same-IID claims. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-uiun 3x codereview.
